description: Create the dedicated Auto Type sidebar view (AutoTypeView.js) exposing ALL typing system settings, status, backend selection, failover chain, health, speed/timing, mode, keybinds, and target/focus controls in the UI. Add it to the sidebar navigation in CheatingDaddyApp.js.
steps: Create src/components/views/AutoTypeView.js as a Lit web component that imports from ../../assets/lit-core-2.7.4.min.js and uses unifiedPageStyles from ./sharedPageStyles.js

Section 1 - Live Status Panel: Show current state (Idle/Typing/Paused/Aborted), active backend name, queue progress (X/Y characters typed), and current WPM. Subscribe to typing events via window.cheatingDaddy.events for real-time updates.

Section 2 - Backend Selection: Dropdown with all 12 backends (win32-sendinput, virtual-keyboard, powershell-addtype, clipboard, powershell, autohotkey, batch-paste, hybrid-typing, nutjs, robotjs, ui-automation, electron-webcontents). Green/grey availability dot per backend. Test button that calls typing:set-backend then typing:start with a test string.
Section 3 - Fallback Chain: Reorderable list with up/down buttons (same pattern as TypingSettingsView.js failover-list). Shows the current failoverChain from settings.
Section 4 - Backend Health: Grid showing backend name, available (yes/no dot), error count, last error. Data from typing:get-status backendHealth field.

Section 5 - Typing Speed & Timing: WPM speed slider (10-300), Startup delay (ms) input (0-2000), Inter-key delay (ms, computed from WPM but overridable), Punctuation delay (ms) input (0-1000), Sentence delay (ms) input (0-2000), Chunk/burst size input (1-10), Jitter/randomization slider (0-100%, maps to 0-1.0 jitterRange).

Section 6 - Typing Mode: Granularity select (character/word/sentence/paragraph), Typo simulation toggle, Backspace simulation toggle, Adaptive speed toggle, Hold-to-type mode toggle, Paste mode toggle, Sentence-by-sentence toggle.

Section 7 - Keybinds: Display current hold-to-type key (holdToTypeKeybind), Pause/resume key (holdToType from keybinds), Abort key (abortKeybind), Full-response trigger key (fullResponseKeybind). Editable with input fields that save to typing settings.
Section 8 - Target/Focus: Target lock toggle, Auto-refocus toggle, Clipboard restore toggle, Auto-focus delay (ms) input.
Add import for AutoTypeView in CheatingDaddyApp.js at the top with other view imports.
Add 'auto-type' sidebar item to the items array in renderSidebar() with id: 'auto-type', label: 'Auto Type', and a keyboard/typing SVG icon.
Add case 'auto-type' to renderCurrentView() switch statement: return html`<auto-type-view></auto-type-view>`
Register the custom element at the bottom of AutoTypeView.js: customElements.define('auto-type-view', AutoTypeView)
acceptance_criteria: AutoTypeView.js exists and exports the AutoTypeView class
Sidebar has an Auto Type nav item between existing items
renderCurrentView has an auto-type case that renders <auto-type-view>
All 8 sections are present in the render method
Component subscribes to typing events for live status updates
verification: Run: node -e "require('/projects/sandbox/cd/src/storage.js')" to confirm storage.js still loads without errors
Run: npx prettier --check src/components/views/AutoTypeView.js src/components/app/CheatingDaddyApp.js to verify code style
findings: AutoTypeView.js created with all 8 sections. Prettier reformatted trailing commas in arrow functions inside template literals. storage.js loads fine. No test framework to run. Sidebar item placed after hotkeys, before models.
